channel.title: Ghana - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Ghana, every source cited.

item.title: Ghana government funds mother's travel to son's New York funeral
item.description: Foreign Affairs Minister Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa announced the government will cover all costs for Madam Doris Adu Gyamfi to attend the service.

item.title: Ghana wins financial gold war but loses environmental one
item.description: An associate professor says the Ghana Gold Board mobilises gold to support the economy and stabilise the Cedi.

item.title: Joseph Assempah named printing CEO of the Year
item.description: Assempahfie Graphics owner recognised for leadership at the 5th Ghana CEO Vision and Awards in Accra.

item.title: Accra shooting kills CEO Irene Atubiga and uncle
item.description: Police arrested a woman and seek Samuel Osei Anto for the Friday, October 30, 2026, double murder.

item.title: National Theatre to host Funworld 2026
item.description: The fifth edition of Funworld will use performing arts to promote mental health awareness and breast cancer education.
